fixed: "counter clockwise", "counter-clockwise", "anti-clockwise" and "ccw" are now understood for gates, facing stars and poussettes when you import or type a figure, and clockwise/counterclockwise are understood for circles (clockwise is a circle left, counterclockwise a circle right).
Figure parser reads every spin direction through one reader, accepting hyphenated and spaced counter-clockwise forms; circles map spin words to left/right and leave contradictory lines custom.
